text:
sre-eli: Heads-up — scheduling a coordinated maintenance for Sat 02:00 UTC. This is a combined DB migration + egress QOS adjustment that will require rolling soft-reboots of a subset of GPU hosts in az3 to free slots for the migration agent. Expect ~10% capacity reduction in az3 during the window.
infra-ana: ETA and exact host list? can we limit impact to non-critical pools? :thinking_face:
ops-joe: plan: 02:00–04:00 UTC. We'll target: pool-saturn-interruptible (40%), pool-meridian-burst (20%), avoid dedicated tenant pools. Host list attached in the runbook (see gist): https://gist.github.com/redwood/maintenance-az3-1751234567
oncall-bot: Reminder: Please add the maintenance to the calendar and run the preflight checklist 24h prior.
product-kim: Any customer-facing risks? we have one mid-market customer with a latency-sensitive model in az3.
sre-eli: Good catch — we'll stencil that tenant to the high-availability tier during the window (route to us-west fallback) and throttle background batch jobs. Notifying CS.
infra-ana: Ops details: before each host soft-reboot we will: 1) cordon 2) drain pods with `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30` 3) run `preflight-evict-check --tenant-exempt=redwood-pro` 4) reboot and validate.
ops-joe: We'll pre-seed KV cache on warmback hosts to reduce cold cache penalties. Script: `./scripts/kv-seed --pool pool-meridian-burst --samples 5000`
product-kim: What's the expected cost impact? we're watching $/token.
sre-eli: Short window, but burst fallback to us-west increases egress by ~120GB/hr. Ballpark additional infra cost: ~$90/hr if fallback sustained. We'll monitor and kill non-essential batch jobs to stay under $50/hr.
infra-ana: QOS change: egress shaping will drop from 10Gbps->7Gbps per node for the cohort during migration. This is temporary and staged per rack to avoid global congestion.
ops-joe: Canary plan: pick 2 nodes first, observe model latency and error rate for 15m, then proceed in 10-node batches. If 5xx > 1% or tail latency +50ms, immediate rollback.
product-kim: Could we do a blue-green style migration for the DB instead to avoid node reboots?
sre-eli: Tried — blue-green requires write-fanout changes that break our streaming ingest pipeline for now. Migration tooling requires short windows for metadata locks; reboots reduce contention risk.
infra-ana: TL;DR runbook excerpt (copy): ```
- Preflight 24h: notify customers, run `telemetry smoke` and `evac-check`
- T-30m: disable autoscaler for affected pools
- T-10m: mark maintenance tag on hosts
- Stage A: canary 2 nodes (15m observation)
- Stage B: batches of 10 nodes with 5m gap between batches
- Post: run `kv-verify --samples 1000`, restore autoscaler
```
ops-joe: I'll post play-by-play in this thread during the window. tagging @oncall for escalation.
oncall-bot: oncall rotation: dana (primary), lee (secondary). Pager policy unchanged.
product-kim: Thanks — please add the CS notification copy to the doc. I'll send a targeted message to the customer with fallback details.
sre-eli: Noted. If any node shows GPU memory pressure after warmback, we'll hold and escalate to runtime team. Also: watch NVLINK error counters during reboots — we saw a transient bump in prior window.
infra-ana: ok set. final checklist updated in the gist. I'll run a rehearsal tomorrow in staging at 13:00 UTC.
ops-joe: rehearsals welcome — volunteers? I'll coordinate.
sre-eli: thanks all. Will follow-up with a short status update 12h before and then 1h before the window. :white_check_mark:
